description: Reddit subreddit identity and activity over time, via the Arctic Shift archive: subscriber count, subreddit creation date, all-time post/comment totals, earliest indexed post/comment, and monthly post/comment counts within a date window (default: the last 12 months). A subreddit Arctic Shift has never indexed is reported as a loud not-found error, never a silent empty result.

after.description: Optional ISO date (e.g. "2024-01-01") for the monthly-activity window; default is 12 months ago.

before.description: Optional ISO date (e.g. "2025-01-01") for the monthly-activity window; default is today.

subreddit.description: Subreddit name without the r/ prefix, e.g. "datasets".

name: subreddit_activity
title: Subreddit Activity
